wiki.summary: “Pop this Heat” is the fifth track on JPEGMAFIA’s seventh studio album, EXPERIMENTAL RAP, and was initially played in snippet form throughout the album's trailer. The song also samples “The Way“ by Ariana Grande & Mac Miller, which itself samples “A Little Bit of Love“ by Brenda Russell. Read more on Last.fm.
